title: Use Story Studio Canvas to organize characters, scenes, and story flow before…
content: Use Story Studio Canvas to organize characters, scenes, and story flow before generating to maintain visual consistency across an entire Seedance 2.5 project.
tips: Use Story Studio Canvas to organize characters, scenes, and story flow before generating to maintain visual consistency across an entire Seedance 2.5 project.

es.content: Utiliza Story Studio Canvas para organizar personajes, escenas y el flujo de la historia antes de generar, para mantener la consistencia visual en todo un proyecto de Seedance 2.5.

fr.content: Utilisez Story Studio Canvas pour organiser les personnages, les scènes et le déroulement de l'histoire avant de générer afin de maintenir une cohérence visuelle sur l'ensemble d'un projet Seedance 2.5.

ja.content: Seedance 2.5プロジェクト全体で視覚的一貫性を維持するために、生成前にStory Studio Canvasを使用してキャラクター、シーン、ストーリーの流れを整理します。

ko.content: Seedance 2.5 프로젝트 전체에서 시각적 일관성을 유지하기 위해, 생성 전에 Story Studio Canvas를 사용하여 캐릭터, 장면 및 스토리 흐름을 조직하세요.

pt.content: Use o Story Studio Canvas para organizar personagens, cenas e o fluxo da história antes de gerar, a fim de manter a consistência visual em todo o projeto Seedance 2.5.

zh.content: 在生成之前使用 Story Studio Canvas 来组织角色、场景和故事流程，以在整个 Seedance 2.5 项目中保持视觉一致性。
